scenes.title: Great Expectations (Suites & Checkpoints)
scenes.subtitle: Declarative, testable data expectations
scenes.narration: Great Expectations lets teams declare expectations about their data and run them as automated, version-controlled tests.

scenes.heading: Core building blocks
bullets: Expectation: a single assertion about the data
Expectation Suite: a named collection of expectations
Checkpoint: bundles a suite with a batch of data to validate
Data Docs: human-readable reports of validation results
scenes.narration: An expectation is one testable assertion, such as a column having no nulls. A suite groups related expectations for a dataset so they can be versioned and reused. A checkpoint pairs a suite with a specific batch of data and runs the validation, and Data Docs render the outcome as readable reports for the whole team.

scenes.heading: The Great Expectations workflow
steps: Curate the expectations into a suite
Run a checkpoint against new batches
Publish results to Data Docs and alerts
scenes.narration: You usually start by profiling a sample so the tool suggests reasonable expectations automatically. You then curate those into a suite, keeping the ones that reflect true business rules. A checkpoint runs the suite against each new batch, and the results flow into Data Docs and any configured alerting.

scenes.heading: Defining expectations
scenes.code:
import great_expectations as gx

context = gx.get_context()
validator = context.sources.pandas_default.read_csv("orders.csv")

validator.expect_column_values_to_not_be_null("order_id")
validator.expect_column_values_to_be_between("amount", min_value=0, max_value=10000)
validator.expect_column_values_to_be_in_set("status", ["new", "paid", "shipped"])

validator.save_expectation_suite("orders_suite")
result = context.run_checkpoint(checkpoint_name="orders_checkpoint")
print(result["success"])
scenes.narration: Here we attach a validator to the orders data and declare three expectations directly on it. The assertions cover completeness of the identifier, a valid numeric range for the amount, and an allowed set of statuses. Saving the suite persists these rules, and running the checkpoint validates a batch and reports overall success.

scenes.text: Suites make expectations reusable and versioned; checkpoints run them and publish results your whole team can read.
scenes.narration: Great Expectations treats data quality as testing, so rules live in code and evolve with review. Profiling accelerates the first draft, but curation ensures the suite reflects real business intent.
